steps.action: Set reminder lead times, steps 1-2: profile menu > Settings > Organization > Notifications shows Reminder lead times; Personal > Notifications changes only your preferences
steps.expected: Organization > Notifications shows the Reminder lead times list; Personal > Notifications shows Notification preferences and the personal lead time switch.
steps.actual: Organization > Notifications opened /settings/reminders with headings ["Personal","Organization","Comment emails","Reminder lead times"] and the list ["30 days before","14 days before","7 days before","1 day before","On the day"]; the note reads "These are the default lead times for expiries, notice deadlines, Key dates and obligations. People can set their own in Notifications. Keep at least one lead time.". Personal > Notifications opened /settings/notifications with Notification preferences and the switch "Use the organization's default lead times".

steps.action: Steps 3-5: Add lead time with Save; Cancel discards; a duplicate and 731 are refused; reorder with the arrow keys; Remove; reload and confirm; at most 20 entries
steps.expected: The new lead time is added; duplicates and 731 are refused; the reorder persists after reload; a 21st entry is refused; Remove removes an entry.
steps.actual: Add lead time with 33 and Cancel saved nothing. 9 + Save added "9 days before". A second 9 stayed in the add row with "days before the date 9 days before is already on the list. Save Cancel"; 731 with "days before the date Enter a whole number of days between 0 and 730. Save Cancel". "On the day" (0) is on the list: true. ArrowUp moved "9 days before" from 6 to 5; after reload the list read ["30 days before","14 days before","7 days before","1 day before","9 days before","On the day"]. 14 temporary entries filled the list to 20; 90 was then refused with "days before the date The list holds at most 20 lead times. Remove one first. Save Cancel" and the list stayed at 20. Remove took the temporary entries away again.

steps.action: Choose whether comment emails carry the words: Comment emails card, Include comment words in email, on by default; saves on change; recorded as an Administrator-only Audit log event
steps.expected: The switch starts on, turns off and saves, and the Audit log shows the change with an Administrator audience; it is put back on.
steps.actual: The Comment emails card's switch started on (true); help "Applies to everyone in the organization. Audit log Search "comment" shows 6 of Daniel Okafor's rows, newest "Daniel Okafor changed the organization settings commentWordsInEmail: No → Yes System Administrators this minute".
